from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, json, sys, tempfile, time

bridge=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
bus=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-command-bus'
sys.path.insert(0,str(bridge))
sys.path.insert(0,str(bus))

def load(name,path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name]=mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod

router=load('installed_active_router',bridge/'command_router.py')
assert getattr(router.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatCommandRouter/0.3-active-page'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    active=Path(td)/'active_page.json'
    router.ACTIVE_PAGE_FILE=active
    state=router.update_presence('chat-runtime-1234','tab-runtime-1234',True,True)
    assert state['active'] is True
    poller=load('installed_active_poller',bus/'command_bus_poller.py')
    poller.ACTIVE_PAGE_FILE=active
    route,source=poller.resolve_route({'notes':''})
    assert source=='active_page'
    assert route=={'chat_id':'chat-runtime-1234','consumer_id':'tab-runtime-1234'}
    active.write_text(json.dumps({'active':True,'chat_id':'chat-runtime-1234','consumer_id':'tab-runtime-1234','updated_at_unix':time.time()-60}))
    route,source=poller.resolve_route({'notes':''})
    assert route is None and source=='active_page_required'
script=(bridge/'prediction-chat-wake.user.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for needle in ('// @version      0.5.0','async function publishPresence()','`${COMMAND_BASE}/presence`','document.hasFocus()','setInterval(publishPresence, 2000)','@updateURL    http://localhost:8765/prediction-chat-wake.user.js'):
    assert needle in script, needle
print('INSTALLED_ACTIVE_PAGE_ROUTING_E001=PASS')
print('ROUTER_VERSION='+router.Handler.server_version)
